rationale: Pivot from torch_time_moe (saturated 0/7 across 15 HP sweeps iters #893-#906, avg_ann +35% to +58% but never passes any single window's WR/DD jointly) to tabm_classifier. Default-HP first-shot scored 1/7 with avg_ann +30.8% and cracked the W1 graveyard (0/20 across last 20 torch_time_moe+mlp iters → +220% ann, WR 42.3%, DD 8.6%). The 11-dim TabM HP space has direct levers on the threshold-collapse failure mode (W3-W7 all collapsed to thr=0.0): (a) lower dropout 0.0-0.05 to reduce ensemble-member randomness and sharpen calibration, (b) larger k=64 to add probability dispersion, (c) higher weight_decay 1e-2..1e-1 to regularize against bull-train/bear-test overfit, (d) longer max_epochs=200 + patience=20 to let BatchEnsemble members fully decorrelate. Train mode should focus the sweep here; mlp_classifier and torch_time_moe HP spaces have plateaued.
